question: 只看城市 Midway 的 2000 年销售额是多少？
expected_sql: SELECT SUM(store_sales.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales_price FROM atlas.dwd.store_sales AS store_sales INNER JOIN atlas.dwd.date_dim AS dim_date ON store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = dim_date.d_date_sk INNER JOIN atlas.dwd.dim_store AS dim_store ON store_sales.ss_store_sk = dim_store.s_store_sk WHERE dim_date.d_year = 2000 AND dim_store.s_city = 'Midway' LIMIT 100
